name: io.github.smlfg/hai-mcp
title: HAI-MCP
description: Model-agnostic MCP control plane for HAI: bounded missions, owner-gated actions, drift checks.

environmentVariables.name: HAI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the global HAI state (missions, leases, proofs). Default: ~/.hai

environmentVariables.name: HAI_OWNER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the owner out-of-band channel (one-time nonces). Deliberately outside HAI_HOME. Default: ~/.hai-owner

environmentVariables.name: HAI_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host for streamable-http transport. Refused unless loopback or HAI_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: HAI_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required to accept non-loopback streamable-http connections. Loopback binds without a token.
